role.es: dueño de Hoteles Olivares, segundo marido de Marta
role.en: Owner of Hoteles Olivares, Marta's second husband

bio.es: Pelayo es el difunto segundo marido de Marta. Su relación comenzó por negocios y luego ambos descubrieron que compartían un mismo secreto: los dos eran homosexuales. Pelayo le propuso casarse para protegerse de los prejuicios de la sociedad y mantener las apariencias, mientras cada uno vivía su verdadera vida en secreto. Después de la boda, Pelayo quiso controlar la vida de Marta. Temía que la gente descubriera su relación con Fina y que su matrimonio era solo una fachada. Por eso quiso mantenerlas alejadas e impedir que se vieran. Aprovechando el secreto de la muerte de Santiago, las manipuló y chantajeó a Fina para obligarla a alejarse de Marta, logrando separarlas durante un largo tiempo.
bio.en: Pelayo is Marta's late second husband. Their relationship began through business, and then they both discovered that they shared the same secret: they were both homosexual. Pelayo proposed that they marry to protect themselves from society's prejudices and keep up appearances, while each of them lived their true life in secret. After the wedding, Pelayo wanted to control Marta's life. He feared that people would find out about her relationship with Fina and that their marriage was only a facade. That is why he wanted to keep them apart and prevent them from seeing each other. Taking advantage of the secret of Santiago's death, he manipulated them and blackmailed Fina to force her to leave Marta, managing to keep them apart for a long time.
